name: TC-07-work-order-child-records
description: TC-07.3: Work Order Child Records — View WO labor, parts, and equipment tabs

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — Work Order List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Work Order. Work orders contain child records for labor, parts, and equipment tracking.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — Work Order List Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The work order list shows all work orders with their status, priority, type, and assigned resources.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — Work Order Labor List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Work Order Labor. Labor records track hours spent by technicians on each work order.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — New Labor Entry
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to record labor hours. Specify the employee, hours worked, hourly rate, and trade type.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — Labor Entry Form
doc_metadata.caption: The labor entry form captures employee, hours, rate, and total cost. The system calculates the line total (hours × rate) automatically.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — Work Order Parts List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Work Order Parts. Parts records track materials and spare parts consumed during maintenance work.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — New Parts Entry
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to record parts consumed. Select the item, quantity, and unit price.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — Parts Entry Form
doc_metadata.caption: The parts entry form captures item, quantity, unit price, and calculated total. Parts consumption is deducted from inventory when the work order is completed.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — Work Order Equipment List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Work Order Equipment. Equipment records track tools and vehicles used during work order execution.

doc_metadata.title: TC-07.3 — Work Order Equipment Overview
doc_metadata.caption: The work order equipment list shows all equipment assigned to work orders with usage hours and associated costs.
